title: 법원청사건축심의위원회규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson)
(1) The Deputy Minister of the National Court Administration shall serve as chairperson, and the Director General of the Planning and Coordination Office shall serve as vice-chairperson. <Amended on August 21, 1995; January 13, 2006; February 9, 2009; May 1, 2020>
(2) The chairperson shall preside over the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
(3) The vice-chairperson shall act on behalf of the chairperson where the chairperson is unable to perform duties.
(4) Deleted. <May 1, 2020>
